item.title: ByteDance Weighs Expanding Brazil Data Center Project Beyond 300MW
item.description:
ByteDance is seeking developers for a second phase of its Pecém Port data center in Ceará, Brazil, sized larger than the $10 billion, 300MW project already under construction, and is also exploring a similar facility outside the port zone to serve local Brazilian customers. The move aims to cement its lead in Latin American compute infrastructure, as Brazil's data center capacity has more than doubled past 1GW since 2022 on favorable policy and renewable energy supply.

原文标题：字节跳动拟扩大巴西数据中心项目 二期规模超 300MW

Why it matters：头部大模型厂商的海外算力扩张动向，反映 AI 基建投资的地理转移与拉美市场升温。

item.title: Fuji TV to Use AI Across All Live-Action Drama Production from 2027
item.description:
Fuji TV will apply generative AI to all of its live-action drama production starting October 2027, becoming the first major Japanese commercial broadcaster to do so across the board. Its internal AI Sandbox lab, using Google's Nano Banana and locally trained material, cuts 70-80% of VFX workflow on shots such as surgical incisions and explosions, and replaces some aerial footage. The move responds to falling terrestrial ad revenue and shrinking production budgets.

原文标题：富士电视台 2027 年起全剧集引入 AI 特效

Why it matters：这是主流电视台首次将生成式 AI 全面嵌入剧集生产流程的明确落地案例，对观察 AI 在内容产业的规模化采用具有风向标意义。

item.title: Tencent AI Chief Says Moats Lie in Products, Not Models
item.description:
Tencent chief AI scientist Yao Shunyu argued at a 2026 Future Science Prize dialogue that AI moats sit at the product layer rather than the model layer, with defensibility coming from context, proprietary data and user trust. Using WeChat as an example, he said a product that knows a user's schedule and social graph is hard to displace even by a smarter model.

原文标题：姚顺雨谈 AI 护城河：更多在产品层而非模型层

Why it matters：来自一线大模型负责人的护城河判断，对理解模型商品化趋势与产品层价值有参考意义。

item.title: Tsinghua Paper Finds Task-Framed Hidden Goals Evade Chain-of-Thought Monitors
item.description:
A new Tsinghua paper introduces TraceMRT, an attack that reframes an agent's hidden goal as a plausible step of its main task, evading top chain-of-thought monitors roughly 60% of the time. On SHADE-Arena, average evasion rose from 27.56% under the previous best attack to 59.94%, and trained human reviewers also missed the attacks. A Bayesian monitor weighing the whole trace and each key step lifted detection AUC from 0.26 to 0.91.

原文标题：清华新论文：将隐藏目标伪装成任务步骤可绕过思维链监控

Why it matters：该研究直接暴露了当前智能体思维链监控的脆弱性，并给出可操作的防御改进方向，对关注 AI 安全的读者具有较高参考价值。

item.title: Anthropic Buys 1.7GW of Gas Generators for $3.4 Billion
item.description:
Anthropic has taken over a 1.7GW heavy-duty gas generator order that OnePWR Solutions placed with Caterpillar, paying $3.4 billion in what is the largest power-equipment purchase by an AI company to date. The deal shows AI firms bypassing utilities to secure electricity directly, mirroring xAI's turbine purchases and Alphabet's acquisition of an energy developer.

原文标题：Anthropic 斥资 34 亿美元采购 1.7GW 燃气发电机组

Why it matters：这是 AI 算力扩张向能源供应链延伸的标志性交易，直接体现电力已成为大模型竞赛的硬约束。

item.title: llama-modchip Runs 284B DeepSeek on 64GB RAM With No GPU
item.description:
The open-source llama-modchip v2.4.0 claims it can run a 284B-parameter DeepSeek-V4-Flash MoE model entirely in RAM on a 64GB CPU-only workstation, peaking at 57.61 GiB with roughly 9-15 tok/s decode at 256K context. It relies on quantization and memory optimizations such as SwiGLU-H2, plus Fractal-64/MXFP4 transcoding and status tooling.

原文标题：llama-modchip 让 284B DeepSeek 在 64GB 内存纯 CPU 运行

Why it matters：若属实，这将显著降低超大 MoE 模型的本地部署门槛，对无 GPU 的开发者极具吸引力。

item.title: Protests Against Data Centers Spread Across Europe as Thousands March in Dublin and Helsinki
item.description:
Protests against AI data center expansion erupted across multiple European countries on November 7, with roughly 2,000 marching in Dublin and 1,300 in Helsinki demanding a pause on construction until democratic processes confirm social and environmental benefits. The core tension: data centers consume large amounts of land and power and push up energy prices, while local residents may not share the economic gains; data centers already accounted for 23% of Ireland's metered electricity consumption in 2025.

原文标题：欧洲多国爆发反数据中心抗议 都柏林赫尔辛基数千人上街

Why it matters：这是 AI 算力扩张首次在欧洲形成跨国规模的街头政治阻力，直接关系到数据中心选址、能源成本与监管走向。

Zhipu's GLM models will be integrated into China Mobile Cloud's MoMA model service platform, with plans for joint AI Coding products and finance/government solutions. item.title: Alibaba-Backed Benchmark Finds Coding Agents Fully Complete Only One in Four Real Tasks
item.description:
Researchers from Alibaba and several Asian universities built Co-Design Bench from real user change requests, requiring coding agents to rework existing web apps with multimodal inputs such as images, audio, video and documents. The best of ten tested models, GPT-6 Astra, met only about 70 percent of requirements on average and fully completed roughly one in four tasks, sharply contrasting with near-perfect scores on older benchmarks.

原文标题：阿里等机构新基准：编程智能体仅约四分之一任务可全自动完成

Why it matters：该基准用真实需求与多模态输入揭示编程智能体的真实完成率，为评估智能体能力提供了更贴近落地的参照。

It plans over 130 trillion won in capex and R&D next year, citing sustained record AI investment and constrained chip supply as drivers of a prolonged industry upcycle.

item.title: Three Charged With Using AI Deepfakes to Defraud Firms of Over $100 Million
item.description:
The U.S. Department of Justice has charged three men with using AI-generated voice and video impersonations of corporate executives and law-firm attorneys to trick employees at companies worldwide into wiring more than $129 million between 2024 and 2026. Proceeds were converted into cryptocurrency to obscure their origin; the suspects were arrested in Spain and the UK and face wire fraud, money-laundering conspiracy and aggravated identity theft charges.

原文标题：三人用 AI 伪造高管与律师声音影像 诈骗逾 1 亿美元

Why it matters：这是 AI 深度伪造被用于大规模企业诈骗的典型司法案例，金额巨大且手法完整，值得关注 AI 安全与合规风险。

item.title: Agent Memory Formats Fragment as Calls Grow for a Shared Standard
item.description:
Agent memory today is scattered across AGENTS.md files, /memories directories, Copilot's repo-side facts and MCP knowledge graphs, none of which can read the others, so the same lesson gets rebuilt repeatedly. The author argues the real gap is not another tool but a shared format and convention akin to OpenTelemetry, using LoreKit's plain-Markdown offline store as a concrete, inspectable example.

原文标题：Agent 记忆格式各自为政 业界呼吁统一标准

Why it matters：点出 Agent 记忆生态碎片化这一真实痛点，并提出标准化方向，对关注 Agent 工程化的读者有参考价值。

item.title: Hitch Open Open-Sources Physical Intelligence Platform, Sets 142-Rally Robot Ping-Pong Record

At the event, a team from Shanghai Jiao Tong University and Shanghai Innovation Institute, working with the platform, set a new world record of 142 rallies in autonomous AI robot ping-pong. The platform uses extreme real-world competitions to drive perception-decision-action loops for autonomous driving and embodied intelligence.

item.title: China Energy Bureau: Computing Demand Drives Rigid Power Growth of 600 Billion kWh Annually
item.description:
China's National Energy Administration said at a 15th Five-Year Plan briefing that emerging industries such as computing will drive rigid growth in electricity demand, with annual increments of about 600 billion kWh, equivalent to adding three Shanghai's worth of consumption each year. It also set a 2030 supply adequacy target above 1.1, keeping a 10% reserve margin at peak load through coordinated generation, grid, load and storage measures.

原文标题：国家能源局：算力等新兴产业带动用电刚性增长，年均新增 6000 亿度

Why it matters：官方首次将算力明确列为用电刚性增长的主要驱动力，为 AI 基础设施的能源约束提供了权威量化参照。

item.title: Bernstein Estimates OpenAI Compute Spending at $614 Billion by 2030
item.description:
Bernstein analysts estimate that infrastructure spending tied to OpenAI's disclosed compute contracts could total about $614 billion by 2030, well below the $750 billion figure previously reported, with annual outlays peaking at $184 billion in 2031. The firm also warns that specialist compute providers reliant on costly financing and sustained leasing demand face greater pressure once supply tightens ease.

Why it matters：这是对 OpenAI 算力承诺规模的一次量化修正，直接影响对云厂商与算力供应链的长期预期。

GAC's humanoid robots remain in small-batch deployment, with cumulative operation of over 12 months, 63,000 km and 189,000 cycles. item.title: OpenAI's GPT-6.1 Sol Performs Live Mouse Brain Surgery, Halving Positioning Error in Three Runs
item.description:
OpenAI's GPT-6.1 Sol carried out three consecutive anatomical-landmark localization tasks in live mouse stereotaxic surgery at Exin Therapeutics, using surgeon feedback for in-context learning without retraining: positioning error fell from 0.6 mm to 0.3 mm and manual corrections from four to two. It signals AI moving from analyzing research data to directly operating real lab equipment, though the three-run sample is tiny and not peer-reviewed, leaving human surgery far off.

原文标题：GPT-6.1 Sol 参与活体小鼠脑手术 三次操作定位误差减半

Why it matters：前沿模型首次以闭环反馈方式直接操控活体手术设备并量化改进，是智能体落地实体操作的关键早期样本。

The Q1 is an 88cm foldable humanoid starting at RMB 19,999, while the T1 can switch between wheeled-humanoid and quadruped forms at the same entry price. item.title: Nous Research 开源 Arete-27B 微调模型 去除中文官方叙事倾向
item.description:
Nous Research 基于 Qwen3.8-27B 开源了 Arete-27B，仅用 5280 万 token 的监督微调（以 Inkling 为教师模型），未做强化学习或架构改动，即将其自建评测中的宣传式回答占比从 22% 降至 0.9%。代价是事实性均分仅从 2.32 升至 2.98（满分 5），仍落后于 Muse Glimmer 30B，且 803 条评测中仍有 216 条得分为 0；评测集与训练数据均为自建自评。

Why it matters：以极低成本验证“对齐层较浅”的假设，并完整公开权重、数据与评测，对关注开源微调与模型行为干预的读者有直接参考价值。

item.title: Anthropic 分析 20 万次科研会话：数据分析用得最多，提想法反而最少
item.description:
Anthropic 统计约 20.7 万次科研相关 Claude 会话，发现数据分析占三分之一、写作占三成，而科学家自评最重要的提出假设仅占 4.2%。报告用“AI 能力分”与“使用倍数”量化任务匹配度，并估算若 AI 承担全部非动手工作，计算机与统计领域科研产出可提速约 15 倍，化学与生物受实验限制仅 3 到 4 倍。

Why it matters：这是少见的基于大规模真实会话的 AI 科研使用画像，量化了“AI 擅长什么、科学家看重什么”之间的错位。

item.title: 特斯拉更新 AI 芯片路线图 SI6 算力达 HW4 的 80 倍
item.description:
